```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library}
# library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

```


```{r parameters}
year_to_load <- 2018
to_sample <- TRUE
version <- "v2"
suffix <- paste0(ifelse(to_sample, "_sampled_", "_full_"), version)
```

```{r read python}
pdt <- fread(here(intermediate_path, paste0("python_output_", year_to_load,".csv")))

rdt <- fread(here(intermediate_path, paste0("output_", year_to_load, suffix, ".csv")))

# Define a function to safely split strings
safe_split <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  } else {
    result <- strsplit(as.character(x), "\\|")[[1]]
    if (length(result) == 0 || all(result == "")) {
      return(NA_character_)
    } else {
      return(result)
    }
  }
}

# Apply the safe_split function to the specified columns
rdt[, clin_icd := lapply(clin_icd, safe_split)]
rdt[, clin_rvs := lapply(clin_rvs, safe_split)]
rdt[, icd9_list := lapply(icd9_list, safe_split)]
rdt[, rvs_unmap_list := lapply(rvs_unmap_list, safe_split)]

setnames(pdt, old = c("clin_sdx", "clin_proc", "xrvs_unmap", "clin_pdx", "clin_pdx_code"), 
         new = c("clin_icd", "icd9_list", "rvs_unmap_list", "pdx", "pdx_code"))

# Get column names of both data tables
columns_rdt <- colnames(rdt)
columns_pdt <- colnames(pdt)

# Find common columns
common_columns <- intersect(columns_rdt, columns_pdt)

# Print common columns
print(common_columns)

# Find uncommon columns in rdt
uncommon_in_rdt <- setdiff(columns_rdt, columns_pdt)

# Find uncommon columns in pdt
uncommon_in_pdt <- setdiff(columns_pdt, columns_rdt)

# Print uncommon columns
cat("Columns in rdt but not in pdt:\n")
print(uncommon_in_rdt)

cat("\nColumns in pdt but not in rdt:\n")
print(uncommon_in_pdt)

# Find common columns
common_columns <- intersect(columns_rdt, columns_pdt)

# Subset each data table to keep only common columns
rdt <- rdt[, ..common_columns]
pdt <- pdt[, ..common_columns]

# Print the updated data tables to verify
print(colnames(rdt))

# Apply the conversion function to the specified columns
pdt[, clin_icd := lapply(clin_icd, safe_split)]
pdt[, icd9_list := lapply(icd9_list, safe_split)]
pdt[, rvs_unmap_list := lapply(rvs_unmap_list, safe_split)]

# Select the desired columns
rdt <- rdt[, .(id_series, clin_icd, icd9_list, pdx, pdx_code)]
pdt <- pdt[, .(id_series, clin_icd, icd9_list, pdx, pdx_code)]

# Merge the data tables on id_series
comparison <- merge(rdt, pdt, by = "id_series", all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_rdt", "_pdt"))

# Identify rows where pdx or pdx_code differ
differing_rows <- comparison[pdx_rdt != pdx_pdt | pdx_code_rdt != pdx_code_pdt, ]

# Print differing rows
print(differing_rows)

```
